verdict.rationale: Thoropass advertises 'auditor-vetted native integrations' that connect business tools to the platform and mentions an MCP server with configurable, limited permissions, but the evidence never enumerates a catalog of specific integrations (cloud providers, IdP, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing) nor documents read-only scope options for each connector. missing for 10: a documented integrations catalog listing specific systems, explicit read-only/scope controls per integration, and independent verification of scope granularity.
